What this workflow will never do

Frequently asked questions

Common questions about file a collection harassment complaint

What counts as debt collector harassment?

Threats, profanity, repeated calls, calling before 8am or after 9pm, contacting you at work after being told to stop, and discussing the debt with third parties.

Where do I file?

File with the CFPB (consumerfinance.gov), your state attorney general, and the FTC. You may also sue under the FDCPA.
